notes.title: (1.0.2) The Reaction Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I continue to complete the deficiencies in the game. In the meantime, I want to thank ZeRoyalViking for the video.

If you didn't see,
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OYtduULePsI&t=158s

Update Notes

Added 3 players option.
Added private game option that you can select game modes that whatever you want to play with your party members.

notes.title: (1.0.1) The Reaction Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, just as you know our game has just been available and there are still missing. I'm trying to finish it slowly.


 We could press party member buttons when there were no members, fixed.
 New game mode 'Combined Boxes' added with stats and achievements.
